images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished collectible-figure concept sheet, a 2 by 2 grid of four different cute 3D-printable sculpture design explorations, landscape aspect ratio 3:2. This is a transformation of the attached Clawd pixel character reference into physical vinyl-like figurines, preserve its recognizability: warm terracotta orange broad squat RECTANGULAR main body, small side stubs, FOUR short thick legs, TWO widely spaced simple black square eyes, NO ears, NO antennae, NO long arms, NO large crab claws. Slightly rounded cube corners, minimalist Japanese designer toy charm. White sculpted clouds sit DIRECTLY ON TOP OF its head in every panel; physical contact, no floating pieces. Concept: the pun 'Claude vs Cloud', affectionate satire.
Panel A1 top left: 'CLOUD BERET': tiny fluffy white cloud perched slightly sideways as a beret on top, chubby orange body and very stubby legs, eyes looking subtly upward. This is the recommended cutest main design; cloud about 65% body width. Small stepped orange side stubs.
Panel A2 top right: 'TOO MUCH CLOUD': very wide heavy marshmallow cloud 155% body width resting on top, orange body gently squat under its weight, tiny visible feet, eyes deadpan and endearing. Comic but no pain.
Panel A3 bottom left: 'CLOUD AFRO': a puffy large hemispherical cluster of rounded cloud lobes covering the upper half like fluffy afro hair, exposing the entire orange face; body remains box-shaped with short feet.
Panel A4 bottom right: 'SLEEPY CLOUD': a long low white cloud draped as a sleeping cap on its head, sleepy eyes carved into orange front, four legs tucked low; very peaceful.
Only printed typography beneath each object: A1 CLOUD BERET, A2 TOO MUCH CLOUD, A3 CLOUD AFRO, A4 SLEEPY CLOUD. One restrained sheet heading 'CLAUDE / CLOUD'. Clean cream background, same 3/4 view and comparable tabletop scale, soft studio lighting, subtle grounded shadows, generous whitespace, beautifully tangible satin PLA or vinyl-like objects. Clouds are matte opaque ivory with no blue shadows that suggest an extra material. 3 colors only orange white black. No gradients on object paint. No supporting poles, no balloons, no particles, no tiny unattached details, no watermark. Each figure fully visible separately without borders or overlap. Rounded but not spherical body, must remain recognizable as Clawd. Render actual dimensional sculptures, not 2D pixel art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Design a landscape 3:2 collectible toy concept sheet with FOUR distinct physical 3D-printable figurines in an elegant 2x2 grid on a warm off-white background. Reference image 1 is the identity reference Clawd from Claude Code: warm terracotta orange squat rectangular block body, two widely spaced black SQUARE eyes, short side stubs, four stubby block legs. Keep this identity. Reference image 2 is the blue/purple scalloped cloud/flower Codex icon with white >_ terminal symbol, use its shape for the companion in B4 only. The objective is extremely cute desk companions with simple print-friendly geometry. Round the corners but preserve blocky silhouette. No real crab anatomy, no ears, no antennae, no extra eyes, no human faces, no fur, no glossy resin.
B1 upper left 'SOFT PIXEL': a delightfully tiny plump Clawd, its wide box silhouette softened like marshmallow, front four short chunky block feet visible as a row, 2 inset black square eyes, a little inward relaxed stance, side stubs. No accessories, no cloud. Wider than tall.
B2 upper right 'DESK SITTER': a Clawd sitting on the front edge of a small plain cream plinth, two front chunky orange feet dangle forward and two back feet tucked for support, gentle head/body tilt, two square eyes; recognizable orange block, completely adorable quiet company.
B3 lower left 'TERMINAL HUG': Clawd hugging a single small charcoal black tablet-shaped terminal with raised ivory '>_' on its front, thick side stubs curve just enough around the tablet, squat four feet, tablet bottom also touches floor so no floating component. Tender and protective, black square eyes visible above the tablet.
B4 lower right 'PAIR PROGRAMMING': two companions physically side by side, orange Clawd leaning softly against a freestanding chunky cobalt-blue scalloped flower-shaped Codex icon token with faithful white '>_' glyph, both resting on one low rounded charcoal oval base. Codex has no added eyes or limbs and no extra text. Clear friendship through leaning and proximity.
Text heading 'DESK COMPANIONS'. Under each object exact labels 'B1 SOFT PIXEL', 'B2 DESK SITTER', 'B3 TERMINAL HUG', 'B4 PAIR PROGRAMMING'. Consistent three-quarter front view, the four proposals at comparable scale, full silhouettes visible, wide whitespace, exquisite studio product visualization, subtle matte PLA texture and gentle shadows. Simple orange, black, ivory, blue color blocks. No gradients painted on objects, no tiny separate elements, no floating accessories. Make B1 visibly short, wide and round-cornered; B2 visibly seated; B3 visibly hugging the tablet; B4 visibly two objects leaning together. Not four slight camera variants.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transform the attached reference Codex app icon into a refined concept sheet of four miniature 3D printed physical desk objects. Landscape 3:2, 2x2 grid. The reference is a blue/purple scalloped rounded flower/cloud outline containing a white terminal greater-than chevron and short underscore (>_). Preserve the distinctive scalloped shape and white glyph, including the proportional spacing. White square app tile is optional in variants. No OpenAI knot logo. Crisp, tactile, industrial design prototypes, still friendly beside cute Clawd figurines.
C1 top left 'APP TILE': a thick ivory rounded-square app tile standing on a compact charcoal groove stand. On the face a blue scalloped flower in shallow relief and white raised >_ symbol. Straight clean silhouette, nice bevels, an actual pocket-sized physical object.
C2 top right 'FLOWER TOKEN': freestanding thick blue scalloped Codex outline, no square backing, inset white >_ on the face, sitting directly in a minimal small white saddle foot. See its substantial 10 mm-like thickness and softly rounded edges, lower center lobe physically meets foot.
C3 bottom left 'MONO COIN': a pale warm gray circular coin/medallion LYING nearly flat on the table, a matching single-color embossed scalloped Codex flower with recessed >_ symbol creating shadow contrast. One color, chunky rim, prominent embossing, no colored paint, no text on the coin, not shiny metal.
C4 bottom right 'DARK TOTEM': a charcoal rounded upright rectangular monolith of palm-sized proportions with the scalloped Codex flower in charcoal bas-relief surrounding a raised white >_ on the broad front. Stable deep flat base and thick mass, understated monochrome desktop object. Make the flower outline visible in relief, not a generic terminal icon alone.
Typography: sheet heading 'CODEX OBJECTS'. Precise printed labels below each 'C1 APP TILE', 'C2 FLOWER TOKEN', 'C3 MONO COIN', 'C4 DARK TOTEM'. Light warm neutral background, same gentle studio illumination and 3/4 front view except C3 tilted top view to show coin, all four isolated with plenty of white space, physically credible matte PLA texture, soft grounded shadows. Blue should be a solid mid cobalt color without gradient color paint, white glyphs except single-color C3. Design exploration only, not exploded view, no measures, no CAD grid, no clutter.
